text: Senior Backend Engineer with 8 years building Python services. Designed FastAPI microservices handling 20k requests per minute, migrated a monolith to Postgres with pgvector, owned CI/CD on GitHub Actions. Skills: Python, FastAPI, Postgres, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS.

Frontend Developer, 4 years. Built React and Next.js dashboards with TypeScript and Tailwind. Cut bundle size 40 percent, led accessibility audit to WCAG AA. Skills: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Jest, Playwright, Figma.

Data Scientist with an MSc in Statistics and 5 years in retail forecasting. Built demand models in scikit-learn and PyTorch, deployed batch scoring on Airflow. Skills: Python, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, SQL, Airflow, A/B testing.

Machine Learning Engineer, 6 years. Trained and served transformer models for search ranking, ran distillation of a 7B teacher into a 300M student cutting latency 5x. Skills: PyTorch, Hugging Face, ONNX, Triton, Kubernetes, MLflow.

DevOps Engineer with 7 years automating infrastructure. Terraform modules for multi-region AWS, Prometheus and Grafana observability stack, on-call rotation for 99.95 percent SLA. Skills: Terraform, AWS, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Bash, Go.

Junior Software Developer, recent CS graduate. Internship building REST endpoints in Node.js, capstone project a Django expense tracker with 300 monthly users. Skills: JavaScript, Node.js, Python, Django, SQL, Git.

QA Automation Engineer, 5 years. Owned end-to-end Cypress and Selenium suites, cut regression cycle from 3 days to 4 hours, introduced contract testing with Pact. Skills: Cypress, Selenium, Pact, Python, CI/CD, Jira.

Product Manager with 6 years in B2B SaaS. Shipped a billing platform from discovery to GA, ran quarterly roadmap with three engineering squads, drove 22 percent activation lift. Skills: roadmapping, user research, SQL, Amplitude, Figma.

Mobile Engineer, 5 years native iOS. Swift and SwiftUI apps with 2M downloads, offline-first sync layer with Core Data, reduced crash rate to 0.1 percent. Skills: Swift, SwiftUI, Core Data, Combine, XCTest, Fastlane.

Security Engineer, 6 years in application security. Ran threat modelling for a fintech platform, built SAST and dependency scanning into CI, led SOC 2 evidence collection. Skills: Python, Burp Suite, OWASP, Terraform, IAM, incident response.

We are hiring a Backend Engineer to build and scale Python APIs. You will design FastAPI services, model data in Postgres, and own deployments. Requirements: 5+ years Python, strong SQL, Docker, experience with cloud infrastructure. Nice to have: Kubernetes, Redis, event-driven architecture.

Frontend Engineer wanted for a design-led product team. You will build accessible interfaces in React and TypeScript, collaborate closely with designers, and improve web performance. Requirements: 3+ years React, TypeScript, CSS fundamentals, testing. Nice to have: Next.js, Tailwind, design systems.

Data Scientist role on the forecasting team. You will develop demand and pricing models, validate them offline and in production, and communicate results to commercial stakeholders. Requirements: strong statistics, Python, pandas, scikit-learn, SQL. Nice to have: PyTorch, Airflow, causal inference.

Machine Learning Engineer to productionise NLP models for search. You will fine-tune transformers, optimise inference latency, and own the training pipeline. Requirements: PyTorch, Hugging Face, Python, containerised deployment. Nice to have: distillation, quantisation, Triton or ONNX Runtime.

Site Reliability Engineer opening. You will run our Kubernetes platform, codify infrastructure in Terraform, and improve observability and incident response. Requirements: 4+ years infrastructure, AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, scripting. Nice to have: Go, Prometheus, chaos testing.

Graduate Software Engineer programme. Twelve month structured onboarding across backend and frontend teams. Requirements: CS degree or equivalent, one programming language to a solid standard, willingness to learn, good communication. Nice to have: internship experience, open source contributions.

QA Engineer to own automated testing for our web platform. You will maintain end-to-end suites, triage flaky tests, and embed quality gates in CI. Requirements: 3+ years test automation, JavaScript or Python, CI/CD familiarity. Nice to have: Cypress, performance testing, contract testing.

Senior Product Manager for our payments area. You will own the billing roadmap, define success metrics, and partner with engineering and finance. Requirements: 5+ years product management in SaaS, data literacy, strong written communication. Nice to have: payments or fintech background, SQL.

iOS Engineer to build our consumer app. You will ship features in Swift, improve offline reliability, and raise the testing bar. Requirements: 3+ years native iOS, Swift, UIKit or SwiftUI, App Store release experience. Nice to have: Combine, CI with Fastlane, accessibility work.

Application Security Engineer wanted. You will threat model new services, run secure code review, and automate security testing in the pipeline. Requirements: 4+ years security engineering, OWASP Top 10, scripting in Python, cloud IAM. Nice to have: SOC 2 or ISO 27001 experience, bug bounty triage.
